g.text: PHASE 4: ORDER CREATION (When All Conditions Met)
• Order = Commitment to fulfill (created when safe)
• Conditions = Explicit requirements tracked in DB
✓ Clean rollback (cancel contract, no order exists)
✓ No order number gaps (only assigned when fulfilled)
✓ Better API semantics (contract ID ≠ order ID)
